source.player_type_semantics: pitcher is the all-pitch endpoint presentation mode and is not a pitcher identity filter

conditional_content_type_policy.normalization: lowercase and trim only the MIME token before the first semicolon; retain the full raw header separately without reconstruction

required_transport_and_receipt_gates: final URL exactly equals the hash-bound request URL and no redirect occurred
the exact raw Content-Type and normalized MIME are retained
response byte count is positive and within the authorized maximum
retained Content-Length, when present, is a valid nonnegative decimal exactly equal to the retained response byte count
if Content-Length is absent, separately retained HTTP-client transport-complete evidence is required; otherwise fail closed
retained byte count and SHA-256 exactly reconcile with the request receipt
request-start and response-observation UTC timestamps are retained
attempt journal, request identity, runtime identity, source identity, and authorization identity reconcile
no automatic retry or replacement request exceeds the separately authorized request policy
raw output is written to a new no-overwrite path
required_body_signature_gates: valid UTF-8 decoding with any retained UTF-8 BOM handled explicitly in the validation view
no HTML document signature, doctype, html element, or known HTML error-page marker
no JSON object or array error-body signature after optional UTF-8 BOM and leading whitespace
no Baseball Savant error or warning payload
strict CSV parsing reaches clean EOF
the exact versioned ordered header matches
no missing, unexpected, or duplicate header column exists
every parsed row has exactly the expected field count
no malformed or empty row exists
the final record is complete and correctly quoted
no truncated escape, quoted field, delimiter, or UTF-8 sequence exists

error_signature_policy.json_signature: after optional UTF-8 BOM and leading whitespace, a body beginning with object or array syntax that parses as JSON is rejected
error_signature_policy.inspection_scope: entire decoded body for HTML and JSON signatures; first 8192 raw bytes for versioned Savant transport-error markers

required_identity_and_scope_gates: game_pk, at_bat_number, and pitch_number are positive integral event identities
event identities are globally unique with exact and conflicting duplicates rejected
batter and pitcher are positive MLB identity values
every game_pk belongs to the exact hash-bound certified game universe
the observed game_pk set exactly equals the expected game universe
game_date exactly equals the certified official source date
both batting sides required by the certified game identity are present and internally consistent
canonical teams bind by game_pk plus certified official date plus home or away side plus official team ID
raw team abbreviations are retained as observations and never used as canonical identities
no unresolved official-team or side contradiction exists
required_downstream_reconciliation_gates: plate-discipline description mapping and swing, whiff, contact, take, zone, and chase identities reconcile
zone-domain contradictions fail closed and missing zone is retained explicitly
BBE population and type-description identities reconcile
EV, launch-angle, joint EV/LA, classified, barrel, hard-hit, sweet-spot, and missing-measurement denominators reconcile
all v1 plate-discipline and EV/launch-angle definitions remain unchanged
no fallback parsing, inferred identity, guessed mapping, or repaired raw byte is consumed

required_raw_fields_binding.definition: exactly the required_raw_fields array in immutable source-contract v1

game 717272 certified display SF/OAK versus raw SF/ATH
